description:
HubPost lets you plan, schedule and manage your social media posts from ChatGPT. Connect your HubPost account and ChatGPT can see which social accounts you have linked, list your drafts, scheduled and published posts, and create, edit, reschedule or delete posts on your behalf.

It works with Facebook, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, LinkedIn and Pinterest. Describe a post, pick the account and the time, and it goes into your HubPost queue. Ask what is going out this week, check whether yesterday's post went live, or move a post to a different day, all without leaving the chat.

Sign in with your HubPost account when prompted. A free plan is available at hubpost.co.
